description: Provision a US local number for an inbox. Requires auth. Free includes no numbers (HTTP 402). Starter caps at 3. Pro includes 3 and caps at 25. Each billable number is $3/month with 100 segments. With COOPER_SMS_BILLING=stripe the number is added to the Stripe subscription, prorated, before Cooper buys it. Otherwise billing.status is stub and this call does not charge. The number can receive SMS. Outbound to arbitrary recipients stays disabled until a business registration for that customer exists, which is not available yet, and send returns 409 outbound_not_registered. Inputs: inbox_id (required), area_code or phone_number, idempotency_key (optional). Returns the phone number and billing.
name: cooper_provision_phone_number
title: Provision phone number
